verdict.rationale: All evidence describes consuming Pipedream's existing hosted MCP server (mcp.pipedream.com / remote.mcp.pipedream.net) to call Pipedream's pre-built 3,000+ API integrations on behalf of end users — none of it shows a developer importing their own OpenAPI spec or custom code to generate a new hosted MCP server without protocol plumbing. Missing for 10: any documentation of OpenAPI import, custom-code-to-MCP conversion, or a 'create your own MCP server' workflow.
